svg.title: Spiritual-bliss rates follow different trajectories across four model families

cc:Work.dc:title: Spiritual-bliss rates follow different trajectories across four model families
cc:Work.dc:description: Four aligned line-chart panels trace repeated measured cells for Qwen 27B, Mistral Medium, DeepSeek, and Gemini Flash on a shared percentage scale. Qwen declines, Mistral rises, DeepSeek rises sharply and reverses, and Gemini rises before falling to zero. Points show observed rates and vertical whiskers show 95 percent Wilson intervals.
